case_title.quote: PATHAN HUSSAIN BASHA v. STATE OF A.P.

number_of_accused.correct_value: 3 accused tried (2 appellants before the Supreme Court)
number_of_accused.quote: convicted accused Nos.1 and 2 for the aforementioned offences, however, acquitted accused No. 3
number_of_accused.reason: Three accused were charged and tried; only two remained convicted and appealed.

accused_gender.quote: Accused Pathan Hussain Basha and Pathan Nazeer Abi
accused_gender.reason: Husband (male) and mother-in-law (female) are the appellants.

victim_gender.quote: married to Pathan Haseena Begum (now deceased)

accused_victim_relationship.quote: Accused Pathan Hussain Basha, was married to Pathan Haseena Begum

offence_category.quote: Accused were charged with offences under Sections 498A and 304B of the IPC.

weapon.quote: recovered and seized the saree that had been used for hanging

evidence_type.reason: Oral, medical, recovery evidence all present.

aggravating_circumstances.quote: The period intervening between the marriage and the death of the deceased is very small.

mitigating_circumstances.quote: the age of the accused and the fact that they have already being in jail for a considerable period

trial_court_outcome.quote: sentenced to undergo imprisonment for LIFE for the offence u/s. 304-B IPC

high_court_outcome.quote: acquitted accused No. 3... The sentence awarded by the Trial Court was confirmed.

offence_finally_established.quote: we award ten years Rigorous Imprisonment to the appellants

neutral_facts.quote: found the deceased hanging from the beam with a saree
neutral_facts.reason: Faithful to the facts and does not reveal the outcome.

physical_harm.quote: Oblique ligature mark of 17 x 2.5 cm... Abrasion 1.5 x 1 cm

number_of_offences.quote: Accused were charged with offences under Sections 498A and 304B of the IPC.

financial_property_loss.quote: fan, ring and Rs. 1,000/- in cash, and the balance of the agreed dowry amount

motive.quote: the accused persons used to harass the deceased primarily for non-payment of the amount of dowry

key_evidence_accepted.quote: The statement of this witness i.e. LW-1 is corroborated by LW-3 and LW-7.

witness_credibility.quote: the prosecution by reliable and cogent evidence has established the guilt of the accused

post_offence_conduct.quote: The accused did not care to explain as to how the death of his wife occurred.

custody_duration.quote: already being in jail for a considerable period

legal_representation.quote: Param Kumar Mishra (for Kumud Lata Das) for the Appellant D. Mahesh Babu for the Respondent.

investigation_status.quote: Investigating Officer arrested all the three accused persons.

appeal_history.quote: The appeals are partially accepted to the extent afore-indicated.

prosecution_argument.correct_value: Prosecution case: accused harassed deceased for balance dowry of Rs. 10,000, driving her to suicide.
prosecution_argument.quote: It is the case of the prosecution that for non-payment of dowry, the accused persons harassed the deceased and subjected her to cruelty.
prosecution_argument.reason: Prosecution case is stated, though no separate State submissions are recorded.

defence_argument.quote: we do see some substance in the argument raised on behalf of the appellants

legal_principle_applied.quote: By a deeming fiction in law, the onus shifts on to the accused to prove as to how the deceased died.

precedent_relied_upon.quote: Biswajit Halder alias Babu Halder and Others v. State of W.B.

sentencing_rationale.quote: the Court may take lenient view as far as the quantum of sentence is concerned

judicial_mitigating_factors.quote: the age of the accused and the fact that they have already being in jail for a considerable period

judicial_aggravating_factors.quote: The period intervening between the marriage and the death of the deceased is very small.
